newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Two resign from Czech SPT top board.
newsitem.headline: Two resign from Czech SPT top board.

text.p: Czech telephone monopoly SPT Telecom said on Tuesday that two members of its supervisory board from SPT's Swiss-Dutch partner, Telsource, had resigned.

In a statement, SPT said that Felix Rosenberg, the general director of Swiss Telecom, and Bernadus Verwaayen, president of PTT Telecom Netherlands, had tendered their resignations from SPT's supervisory board at the end of 1996.
"Their decision follows an intensive year's cooperation and support between the two subjects, SPT Telecom a.s. and Telsource," said the statement, quoting Telsource president Bessel Kok.
"The train has set off very well and it is no longer necessary that we retain our positions on the supervisory board," the statement quoted Verwaayen as saying.

The Dutch PTT and Swiss Telecom consortium, Telsource, took a 27 percent stake in SPT Telecom in 1995, and began to share in the management of the country's largest company, alongside Czech management.
SPT spokesman Josef Jurca said he could not give any further explanation for the changes but said that the two new supervisory board members would also come from Telsource.

The supervisory board is the statutory organ of the company which oversees strategic decisions, while the board of directors watches over SPT's daily operations executed by a five-member operational committee.
